snippet.title: Ashes of the Union - Trailer
snippet.description:
Ashes of the Union - a top-down vehicular shooter with roguelike elements set in a Soviet post-apocalypse.

Explore ruined Soviet villages and cities in heavily armed vehicles, searching for valuable resources and information. Battle mutant insects encountered along the way, and overcome challenging landscapes and obstacles.

Get on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3091390/
Get on VKplay: https://vkplay.ru/play/game/ashes_of_the_union/
